integration_and_rollback_strategy.selected_strategy: Unified hardened integration candidate (`release/axo-step-editor-db-safe-rc`) retaining Landing Page V1.8, Workspace tabs, Geometry Library, Attachment composer, non-destructive Classroom retirement (`f8a2c41d9e05`), migration preflight guard, and Step Editor V1 in a single fast-forwardable release train.
integration_and_rollback_strategy.rollback_mechanism: Non-destructive git/deployment rollback to baseline `main` (`bb046fa22aceff47abe22aa783aa64fc65caee13`) or forward `git revert`; database tables and legacy Classroom rows remain intact (`0` rows dropped) and `downgrade()` cleanly handles both legacy-retained and fresh databases.
